validation.notes: Device flows use a test-APK-only recognition service with example words and a timed RMS envelope, not a physical microphone acoustic model. Its final result is delayed to exercise clearing during transcription. Erase all cancels/destroys the current recognizer and detaches it before clearing state so old callbacks cannot restore the draft. The test verifies the existing title/body are unchanged and a restarted Croatian session adds only its new words. Production feedback uses real recognizer RMS callbacks only. The service rejects missing/wrong language tags and Croatian requests that force offline recognition. Physical-phone acoustic accuracy and language-model availability were not tested. The audio recorder was unchanged. The test APK and its leftover automatically selected speech-service setting were removed from the development emulator after checks.
